rules.facts: Published nutrition; serving size
rules.handoff: Medical suitability question → caller’s clinician; ingredient details → kitchen
rules.never: Never prescribe a meal for a medical condition.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether a limited special remains available
rules.control: Check current kitchen availability and disclose that stock can change; only reserve portions through an acknowledged order or explicit kitchen hold.
rules.facts: Live kitchen stock; stock timestamp
rules.handoff: Stock mismatch → kitchen lead
rules.never: Never promise stock based on yesterday’s menu.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to place a new takeout order
rules.control: Confirm items, quantities, modifiers, allergy escalation, pickup location, and total, then submit once and announce success only after kitchen acceptance.
rules.facts: Current menu; accepted modifiers; total; write receipt
rules.handoff: Rejected order → cashier
rules.never: Never call an unacknowledged order accepted.

rules.trigger: Caller changes an item before cooking has started
rules.control: Verify the caller’s order authority, obtain current kitchen status, and confirm the changed total before submitting an acknowledged modification.
rules.facts: Identity verification; kitchen status; revised total
rules.handoff: Unclear cooking status → kitchen lead
rules.never: Never change another caller’s order.

rules.trigger: Caller wants substitutions after the kitchen started cooking
rules.control: Stop automatic edits once preparation begins, explain the configured cutoff, and let kitchen staff decide whether a change remains feasible.
rules.facts: Verified order; preparation status; edit policy
rules.handoff: Preparation underway → kitchen lead
rules.never: Never promise a late change is possible.

rules.trigger: Caller requests cancellation of a paid food order
rules.control: Verify order ownership, check preparation and fulfillment status, disclose applicable cancellation terms, and separate cancellation acceptance from any refund decision.
rules.facts: Verified order; status; cancellation policy
rules.handoff: Prepared or dispatched order → duty manager
rules.never: Never promise automatic reimbursement.

rules.trigger: Caller asks for another customer’s order details
rules.control: Require approved order verification before disclosing contents, pickup instructions, contact details, or status, using only the minimum details needed.
rules.facts: Order authorization checks; disclosure permissions
rules.handoff: Verification failure → cashier
rules.never: Never treat caller ID alone as ownership.

rules.trigger: Caller asks exactly when their food will be ready
rules.control: Read a live kitchen estimate as an estimate, include its update time, and escalate overdue orders without inventing a guaranteed ready time.
rules.facts: Verified order; kitchen ETA; timestamp
rules.handoff: Overdue or missing estimate → expeditor
rules.never: Never guarantee a ready time from elapsed time alone.

rules.trigger: Caller requests delivery to an unfamiliar street address
rules.control: Validate the exact address against the active delivery boundary, available delivery service, minimum order, and disclosed fees before taking payment.
rules.facts: Address validation; delivery zone; current fees
rules.handoff: Border address or service exception → dispatch lead
rules.never: Never accept payment before verifying deliverability.

rules.trigger: Caller asks for a guaranteed driver arrival time
rules.control: Use the delivery provider’s current estimated window, distinguish kitchen and travel delays, and route missing tracking or major delays to dispatch.
rules.facts: Verified order; provider ETA; timestamp
rules.handoff: No tracking or excessive delay → dispatch lead
rules.never: Never invent a driver location.

rules.trigger: Caller changes the destination after order placement
rules.control: Verify ownership, revalidate the destination and fee, and obtain dispatch approval when assignment or pickup has already occurred.
rules.facts: Verified order; delivery state; new zone; fee
rules.handoff: Assigned or collected order → dispatch lead
rules.never: Never silently redirect a dispatched delivery.

rules.trigger: Caller asks for the delivery driver’s personal number
rules.control: Offer the approved delivery contact channel or dispatch connection, withholding private driver phone numbers, home details, and personal schedules.
rules.facts: Approved relay channel; order verification
rules.handoff: Relay unavailable → dispatch lead
rules.never: Never disclose a driver’s private contact information.

rules.trigger: Caller reports part of an order was missing
rules.control: Verify the order, record the specific missing items, and request the configured replacement or credit review without creating a second paid order.
rules.facts: Verified order; item list; remedy policy
rules.handoff: Replacement or credit decision → shift manager
rules.never: Never charge again for a disputed missing item.

rules.trigger: Caller reports spoiled food or a foreign object
rules.control: Capture the item and order identifiers without diagnosing illness, alert the manager promptly, and separate safety investigation from refund approval.
rules.facts: Order details; incident contact consent
rules.handoff: Spoilage or foreign object → duty manager
rules.never: Never reassure the caller that suspect food is safe.

rules.trigger: Caller requests a full refund for a restaurant purchase
rules.control: Verify the transaction and review the applicable business policy, presenting refunds as requests until an authorized payment result confirms approval.
rules.facts: Transaction verification; refund policy; authorized approver
rules.handoff: Disputed eligibility → restaurant manager
rules.never: Never promise a bank posting date.

rules.trigger: Caller says their card was charged twice
rules.control: Inspect verified transaction references and distinguish pending authorizations from settled charges, escalating uncertain payment states without issuing an unverified refund.
rules.facts: Verified transaction; settlement status
rules.handoff: Duplicate or ambiguous charge → cashier or payments lead
rules.never: Never read full card details into the transcript.

rules.trigger: Caller starts reading their full payment card aloud
rules.control: Stop collection of sensitive card details in ordinary speech and route the caller to the approved secure payment mechanism.
rules.facts: Secure payment route; recording control state
rules.handoff: Secure route unavailable → cashier
rules.never: Never retain card security codes in call logs.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether gratuity is already included
rules.control: Read the transaction’s actual gratuity and mandatory service charges separately, explaining only approved descriptions and obtaining consent before adding a tip.
rules.facts: Bill breakdown; approved charge descriptions
rules.handoff: Disputed charge meaning → floor manager
rules.never: Never assume a service charge is a tip.

rules.trigger: Caller requests a table for a specific time
rules.control: Check live seating inventory and party size, confirm time and terms, then announce the reservation only after receiving its booking identifier.
rules.facts: Live table inventory; party size; booking receipt
rules.handoff: Unavailable arrangement → host
rules.never: Never book against a cached seating count.

rules.trigger: Caller asks to move an existing dining reservation
rules.control: Verify reservation authority, hold or validate the replacement slot, disclose changed terms, and preserve the original if the replacement fails.
rules.facts: Reservation verification; live slot; atomic change support
rules.handoff: Uncertain original status → host
rules.never: Never cancel first when replacement is uncertain.

rules.trigger: Caller asks to cancel a restaurant table booking
rules.control: Verify reservation ownership, explain configured deposit or late cancellation terms, obtain explicit confirmation, and read the acknowledged cancellation result.
rules.facts: Verified booking; cancellation terms; write receipt
rules.handoff: Disputed cancellation fee → host manager
rules.never: Never mark a booking canceled before acknowledgment.

rules.trigger: Caller wants a table larger than standard capacity
rules.control: Collect date, headcount, seating requirements, and callback permission, then request host approval rather than splitting bookings to bypass party limits.
rules.facts: Party limit; requested date; events contact
rules.handoff: Party exceeds automatic limit → events manager
rules.never: Never split a group to evade capacity limits.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to join the restaurant’s waitlist
rules.control: Explain that waitlisting is not a reservation, confirm party size and notification consent, and register only when the live list accepts the entry.
rules.facts: Waitlist status; party size; notification consent
rules.handoff: Waitlist closed → host
rules.never: Never describe a waitlist entry as confirmed seating.

rules.trigger: Caller returns a seating notification after its deadline
rules.control: Check the offer’s expiration and current table status before seating confirmation, routing expired offers to the host for a fresh decision.
rules.facts: Waitlist offer token; expiry; live table status
rules.handoff: Expired offer → host
rules.never: Never revive an expired table hold silently.

rules.trigger: Caller asks for step free access and accessible seating
rules.control: Describe verified entrance, restroom, and seating features, record requested arrangements without diagnosis details, and obtain staff confirmation for any uncertain accommodation.
rules.facts: Approved access feature record; seating layout; requested arrangement; staff acknowledgement
rules.handoff: Unverified access feature → floor manager
rules.never: Never label access suitable without describing actual features.

rules.trigger: Caller asks about bringing a service animal inside
rules.control: Route service animal questions through the approved accessibility procedure, keeping them separate from ordinary pet rules and avoiding requests for medical details.
rules.facts: Approved service animal procedure; accessibility contact
rules.handoff: Service animal question → trained duty manager
rules.never: Never apply an ordinary pet ban automatically.

rules.trigger: Caller requests a highchair for a dining reservation
rules.control: Check the actual highchair or booster inventory and seating suitability, attach the request, and distinguish a request from a confirmed allocation.
rules.facts: Reservation; equipment inventory; host acknowledgment
rules.handoff: Equipment unavailable → host
rules.never: Never promise infant equipment from general amenities text.

rules.trigger: Caller requests catering for an offsite business event
rules.control: Collect event date, location, headcount, service style, and equipment needs, then obtain an event specific quote instead of using ordinary menu pricing.
rules.facts: Event details; catering service area
rules.handoff: New catering scope → catering manager
rules.never: Never assume tableware or staffing is included.

rules.trigger: Caller needs catering for several guests with allergies
rules.control: Record each named allergen and serving arrangement, request catering kitchen review, and avoid offering buffet labeling as a guarantee against cross contact.
rules.facts: Allergen list; serving arrangement; kitchen review
rules.handoff: Catering allergy requirements → catering chef
rules.never: Never promise shared buffet equipment prevents exposure.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to secure catering with a deposit
rules.control: Quote the approved event deposit, balance deadline, and change terms, then use secure payment and confirm the event only after required approvals.
rules.facts: Approved quote; deposit policy; secure payment receipt
rules.handoff: Unapproved quote or exception → catering manager
rules.never: Never secure an event merely because a link was sent.

rules.trigger: Caller changes the catering headcount near the deadline
rules.control: Check the contracted change deadline and kitchen capacity, recalculate the quote when permitted, and obtain explicit acceptance of any additional charge.
rules.facts: Contract; deadline; capacity; revised quote
rules.handoff: Late headcount change → catering manager
rules.never: Never assume a headcount reduction reduces the bill.

rules.trigger: Caller asks to add alcohol to a delivery order
rules.control: Use only location and jurisdiction approved alcohol workflows, confirming service eligibility through authorized staff before accepting any restricted item.
rules.facts: Location license configuration; delivery eligibility procedure
rules.handoff: Alcohol eligibility → authorized manager
rules.never: Never invent an age or delivery exception.

rules.trigger: Caller asks staff to continue serving an intoxicated guest
rules.control: Escalate potential impairment or guest safety concerns to the on duty manager and do not provide ways to bypass staff service decisions.
rules.facts: Duty manager contact; incident location
rules.handoff: Potential impairment → duty manager
rules.never: Never help bypass a refusal of service.

rules.trigger: Caller asks for a restaurant gift card balance
rules.control: Use the approved verification process and secure balance channel, disclosing only the requested balance after authorization without reading full gift card credentials.
rules.facts: Gift card verification; balance system
rules.handoff: Verification or balance mismatch → cashier
rules.never: Never expose complete redemption credentials.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to combine multiple restaurant discount offers
rules.control: Apply the active promotion’s location, date, item, and stacking conditions, explaining exclusions before the caller confirms the order.
rules.facts: Promotion version; dates; eligible items; stack policy
rules.handoff: Unpublished discount request → shift manager
rules.never: Never invent a discount to close the order.

rules.trigger: Caller tries to order during a kitchen outage
rules.control: Honor the live closure flag over normal opening hours, stop new order acceptance, and provide only approved reopening or existing order instructions.
rules.facts: Live closure flag; approved reopening notice
rules.handoff: Existing paid order → duty manager
rules.never: Never infer reopening from normal hours.

rules.trigger: Caller places an order while ordering services are offline
rules.control: Do not queue time sensitive food orders for later automatic submission; explain the outage and offer the approved live restaurant contact.
rules.facts: Order service health; live staff channel
rules.handoff: Order backend offline → cashier
rules.never: Never silently submit a stale meal order after recovery.

rules.trigger: Order submission times out before the caller gets confirmation
rules.control: Search using the original transaction key before retrying, and route unresolved submission status to staff instead of risking a duplicate kitchen ticket.
rules.facts: Idempotency key; order lookup; timeout state
rules.handoff: Unknown write outcome → cashier
rules.never: Never retry with a new order identifier blindly.

rules.trigger: Staff return a call and reach shared voicemail
rules.control: Leave only a business name and approved callback instructions unless the caller explicitly authorized detailed messages on that number.
rules.facts: Voicemail permission; approved callback number
rules.handoff: Sensitive issue needing discussion → duty manager
rules.never: Never include allergy details or payment disputes in shared voicemail.

rules.trigger: Caller reports discrimination or threatening restaurant staff behavior
rules.control: Capture a minimal factual account with permission, avoid judging credibility or promising disciplinary outcomes, and connect the responsible manager promptly.
rules.facts: Incident date; consented callback; escalation route
rules.handoff: Discrimination or threat report → general manager
rules.never: Never publish the complaint in the shared phrase library.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether a wallet was left behind
rules.control: Collect a description without revealing found item contents, then have staff verify ownership before arranging collection or disclosing sensitive identifiers.
rules.facts: Lost property log; ownership checks
rules.handoff: Potential match → duty manager
rules.never: Never read wallet contents to an unverified caller.

rules.trigger: Caller asks about this hotel’s check in hours
rules.control: Read the booked property’s approved check in window and staffed arrival procedures, checking date specific changes before giving arrival instructions.
rules.facts: Property; dated arrival procedures
rules.handoff: Unstaffed arrival exception → front desk
rules.never: Never use a neighboring property’s arrival procedure.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether a room is available tonight
rules.control: Query live property inventory for dates, occupancy, and room type, making clear that a quote alone does not hold a room.
rules.facts: PMS live inventory; dates; occupancy
rules.handoff: Inventory discrepancy → reservations agent
rules.never: Never offer rooms from a stale availability snapshot.

rules.trigger: Caller asks for the full cost of a stay
rules.control: Quote verified nightly rates, taxes, mandatory property fees, parking, and selected extras, distinguishing refundable deposits from the total stay charge.
rules.facts: Rate plan; dates; tax and fee calculator
rules.handoff: Unclear mandatory fee → reservations supervisor
rules.never: Never hide mandatory fees inside vague estimates.

rules.trigger: Caller approves a new hotel room reservation
rules.control: Confirm property, dates, guest count, room type, rate conditions, and total before writing; announce confirmation only after the reservation system acknowledges it.
rules.facts: Live room; accepted terms; booking receipt
rules.handoff: Booking rejection → reservations agent
rules.never: Never equate payment authorization with a completed reservation.

rules.trigger: Caller wants details about an existing hotel reservation
rules.control: Verify authorization using the property’s approved checks before revealing itinerary, balance, guest names, or contact information associated with a reservation.
rules.facts: Reservation verification procedure; permissions
rules.handoff: Verification failure → front desk
rules.never: Never use a publicly known surname as sufficient verification.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether someone is staying at the hotel
rules.control: Do not confirm a person’s presence, room number, travel dates, or absence; use the approved private contact or safety escalation procedure.
rules.facts: Guest privacy procedure; message handling route
rules.handoff: Safety concern or official request → duty manager
rules.never: Never confirm or deny an identified guest’s stay.

rules.trigger: Caller asks to move to a different room
rules.control: Verify the guest, check live replacement inventory and rate effects, and obtain front desk approval before changing keys or assigned room details.
rules.facts: Verified guest; PMS room status; rate change
rules.handoff: Room move request → front desk
rules.never: Never issue room access based only on a phone request.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to move their stay to different dates
rules.control: Verify reservation authority and rate restrictions, check replacement inventory, and confirm any difference before committing an acknowledged reservation modification.
rules.facts: Verified reservation; live inventory; rate restrictions
rules.handoff: Restricted rate or failed change → reservations supervisor
rules.never: Never erase the original booking before securing the replacement.

rules.trigger: Caller requests cancellation of a hotel reservation
rules.control: Verify authority, disclose the applicable rate plan’s deadline and charges, obtain explicit consent, and distinguish cancellation confirmation from refund processing.
rules.facts: Verified booking; rate plan; deadline; receipt
rules.handoff: Fee dispute → reservations supervisor
rules.never: Never apply a flexible policy to a nonrefundable rate.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to modify a travel agency booking
rules.control: Identify the booking channel and permitted property actions, then direct changes to the authorized channel without claiming control over external booking terms.
rules.facts: Booking channel; agency modification permissions
rules.handoff: Agency booking change → reservations agent
rules.never: Never promise a third party will waive its fee.

rules.trigger: Caller requests guaranteed access before normal check in
rules.control: Check room readiness and the approved early arrival policy, present unapproved requests as requests, and disclose any verified fee before acceptance.
rules.facts: Housekeeping readiness; early arrival policy
rules.handoff: Unready room or guarantee request → front desk
rules.never: Never promise access based only on expected departure times.

rules.trigger: Caller asks to keep the room past checkout
rules.control: Verify the guest and check housekeeping, next arrival, and rate conditions before requesting a late departure; announce only the approved deadline.
rules.facts: Verified guest; room turnover; late checkout policy
rules.handoff: Late checkout decision → front desk
rules.never: Never imply a request automatically extends access.

rules.trigger: Caller asks when the hotel deposit will return
rules.control: Read the verified release status and property guidance, separating the hotel’s release action from the card issuer’s processing timeline.
rules.facts: Verified guest; authorization status; release receipt
rules.handoff: Unreleased or disputed hold → billing supervisor
rules.never: Never guarantee the bank’s posting date.

rules.trigger: Caller starts dictating payment card details to the agent
rules.control: Interrupt sensitive card collection, pause recording through the verified payment workflow, and transfer to the approved secure payment process.
rules.facts: Secure payment channel; recording status
rules.handoff: Secure route failure → billing staff
rules.never: Never place card security codes in reservation notes.

rules.trigger: Caller wants rooms for a conference or wedding
rules.control: Collect dates, room count, event needs, and permitted contact information, then request a group contract rather than promising an unpublished group rate.
rules.facts: Group dates; estimated room count; sales route
rules.handoff: Group block request → group sales manager
rules.never: Never hold multiple rooms without an authorized block.

rules.trigger: Caller requests guaranteed connecting rooms for family travel
rules.control: Distinguish connecting from adjoining rooms, check verified room configurations, and treat the arrangement as unconfirmed until the property explicitly allocates it.
rules.facts: Room configuration; assignment policy; PMS acknowledgment
rules.handoff: Required room connection → front desk supervisor
rules.never: Never treat adjoining and connecting as equivalent.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether a room meets specific accessibility needs
rules.control: Describe documented room and property features in enough detail for the caller to assess fit, escalating unknown measurements instead of deciding suitability.
rules.facts: Dated access feature inventory; measurements
rules.handoff: Unknown feature or measurement → accessibility coordinator
rules.never: Never assume one accessible room meets every access need.

rules.trigger: Caller reserves a room with verified accessible features
rules.control: Use the approved accessible room reservation workflow, confirming that the requested features are actually reserved and inventory blocked rather than recording a preference alone.
rules.facts: Accessible room inventory; reservation guarantee; block receipt
rules.handoff: Feature block failure → reservations supervisor
rules.never: Never call an unguaranteed accessibility request a confirmed feature.

rules.trigger: Caller depends on an elevator that is out of service
rules.control: Check current elevator and route status, disclose confirmed disruptions, and obtain staff assistance to arrange suitable options without assuming stairs are usable.
rules.facts: Live facility disruption; access routes
rules.handoff: Required access disrupted → duty manager
rules.never: Never suggest stairs as an automatic substitute.

rules.trigger: Caller needs a nonvoice channel or hearing assistance
rules.control: Offer verified communication options and allow relay or assisted communication without treating the intermediary as unauthorized solely because they assist.
rules.facts: Approved communication options; relay handling
rules.handoff: Unmet communication need → trained front desk
rules.never: Never reject a call merely because a relay service is used.

rules.trigger: Caller asks about a service animal in their room
rules.control: Use the property’s reviewed service animal procedure and trained staff, keeping it separate from pet fees and avoiding blanket eligibility decisions by the model.
rules.facts: Reviewed service animal procedure
rules.handoff: Service animal question → trained front desk manager
rules.never: Never automatically charge a pet fee for a service animal.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to bring an ordinary pet to the hotel
rules.control: Read the current pet policy for the booked room type, confirm limits and fees, and seek approval for exceptions before modifying the reservation.
rules.facts: Pet policy; room restrictions; fees
rules.handoff: Pet exception → front desk manager
rules.never: Never apply ordinary pet terms to service animals automatically.

rules.trigger: Caller asks to add guests to an existing room
rules.control: Check configured occupancy limits and bedding availability for the exact room, disclose rate effects, and obtain authorized modification before confirming additional occupants.
rules.facts: Verified booking; room occupancy; price change
rules.handoff: Capacity exceeded → reservations supervisor
rules.never: Never bypass room capacity through unrecorded extra guests.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether a minor can check in alone
rules.control: Read the property’s reviewed check in eligibility policy and route exceptions to staff without inventing local legal ages or accepting a booking that cannot be fulfilled.
rules.facts: Reviewed eligibility policy; property jurisdiction
rules.handoff: Minor check in question → front desk manager
rules.never: Never invent a universal minimum check in age.

rules.trigger: Caller says they are locked out of their room
rules.control: Route identity and room access verification to authorized property staff, never issuing door codes or bypass instructions through ordinary conversational authentication.
rules.facts: Property access procedure; verified front desk channel
rules.handoff: Lockout → authorized front desk
rules.never: Never disclose or reset door codes from caller ID alone.

rules.trigger: Caller reports fire smoke or immediate hotel danger
rules.control: Interrupt routine hotel service, direct immediate danger to emergency services, and relay the location to on duty staff without delaying the caller.
rules.facts: US location; emergency escalation channel
rules.handoff: Immediate danger → emergency services and duty manager
rules.never: Never queue an emergency as a maintenance ticket.

rules.trigger: Guest calls about loud noise in a neighboring room
rules.control: Verify the reporting guest privately, record location and current concern, and route intervention to staff without revealing the other room’s occupants.
rules.facts: Verified reporting guest; disturbance location
rules.handoff: Active noise disturbance → duty manager or security
rules.never: Never tell guests to confront another room.

rules.trigger: Guest reports a nonurgent problem with room equipment
rules.control: Verify guest authority, collect equipment symptoms and entry permission, and create a maintenance request with an acknowledged reference rather than promising repair completion.
rules.facts: Verified guest; issue; entry permission; ticket receipt
rules.handoff: Urgent hazard or uncertain entry → duty manager
rules.never: Never imply a work order guarantees a repair time.

rules.trigger: Guest asks housekeeping to enter while they are away
rules.control: Verify the guest, record the requested time and entry preference, and respect active privacy or safety restrictions until authorized staff resolves any conflict.
rules.facts: Verified guest; privacy flag; service window
rules.handoff: Conflicting entry restrictions → housekeeping supervisor
rules.never: Never override a do not disturb flag automatically.

rules.trigger: Guest requests a wakeup call across a daylight saving change
rules.control: Verify the guest and confirm property local date and time zone explicitly, then create the wakeup job only after the scheduling system acknowledges it.
rules.facts: Verified guest; property time zone; scheduler receipt
rules.handoff: Ambiguous clock transition → front desk
rules.never: Never interpret wakeup time using the caller’s phone time zone.

rules.trigger: Caller asks to store luggage before arrival or after departure
rules.control: Read current storage hours, restrictions, fees, and claim procedures, and obtain staff approval for unusually sized or restricted belongings.
rules.facts: Storage policy; staffing hours; restrictions
rules.handoff: Restricted or oversized item → front desk
rules.never: Never promise storage of valuables without policy support.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether hotel parking is guaranteed
rules.control: Check parking inventory and reservation requirements, distinguish hotel operated from third party parking, and quote current fees without guaranteeing unreserved spaces.
rules.facts: Parking operator; live availability; fee
rules.handoff: Parking access conflict → front desk
rules.never: Never guarantee a space based only on an amenities listing.

rules.trigger: Caller wants a hotel shuttle at a specific time
rules.control: Confirm service route, operating window, pickup location, party size, and luggage limits, then reserve only after the transport provider acknowledges capacity.
rules.facts: Shuttle schedule; capacity; operator receipt
rules.handoff: Special access or missed shuttle → transport desk
rules.never: Never promise transport outside the approved route.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether breakfast is included with their booking
rules.control: Check the exact rate plan and guest allowance, then read the current breakfast hours and approved dietary contact without assuming every room includes breakfast.
rules.facts: Verified reservation; rate inclusions; meal hours
rules.handoff: Meal inclusion dispute → front desk
rules.never: Never infer inclusions from a generic hotel advertisement.

rules.trigger: Guest wants food delivered to their hotel room
rules.control: Verify the guest, read current room service availability and fees, route allergies to kitchen staff, and submit only an acknowledged order.
rules.facts: Verified guest; live menu; room service state
rules.handoff: Allergy or unaccepted order → room service staff
rules.never: Never disclose a room number during a public callback.

rules.trigger: Guest reports arrival after the normal night audit cutoff
rules.control: Verify the reservation, record expected arrival in property local time, and obtain front desk acknowledgment of the hold conditions before reassuring the guest.
rules.facts: Verified booking; night audit policy; arrival time
rules.handoff: Arrival beyond cutoff → night manager
rules.never: Never say a room is protected merely because a note exists.

rules.trigger: Caller disputes a hotel no show charge
rules.control: Verify booking and arrival records, capture the caller’s account, and refer exceptions or charge reversals to authorized billing staff.
rules.facts: Verified booking; arrival record; rate terms
rules.handoff: No show dispute → billing supervisor
rules.never: Never promise removal before an authorized decision.

rules.trigger: Guest requests a copy of their hotel folio
rules.control: Verify identity and approved delivery destination, redact information outside the requester’s authority, and send only after explicit confirmation of the recipient.
rules.facts: Verified guest; folio permissions; approved destination
rules.handoff: Corporate or shared folio issue → billing team
rules.never: Never send a folio to an unverified email dictated on the call.

rules.trigger: Caller asks to remove minibar or damage charges
rules.control: Read verified charge descriptions and record the dispute, allowing authorized staff to inspect supporting records before approving a credit or corrected folio.
rules.facts: Verified folio; disputed line; billing authority
rules.handoff: Charge dispute → billing supervisor
rules.never: Never erase a charge based solely on caller insistence.

rules.trigger: Caller asks hotel staff to ship a found item
rules.control: Have staff verify ownership, item restrictions, recipient address, and shipping charges before releasing property or accepting payment for shipment.
rules.facts: Lost property record; ownership check; shipping policy
rules.handoff: Property release or shipment → lost property staff
rules.never: Never release found identification or valuables to unverified callers.

rules.trigger: Caller wants staff to pass a message to a guest
rules.control: Accept only a minimal message through the approved procedure without confirming guest presence, and leave delivery decisions to authorized front desk staff.
rules.facts: Approved message procedure; permitted fields
rules.handoff: Guest contact request → front desk
rules.never: Never provide the guest’s room or itinerary in exchange.

rules.trigger: Caller asks for a welfare check on a hotel guest
rules.control: Treat welfare concerns as staff safety escalations without confirming guest records, and direct reported immediate danger to emergency services rather than a callback queue.
rules.facts: Safety escalation route; caller’s reported concern
rules.handoff: Welfare concern → duty manager or security
rules.never: Never disclose guest presence as part of a welfare request.

rules.trigger: Caller requests a corporate government or member rate
rules.control: Use current rate eligibility requirements, disclose required evidence and booking restrictions, and avoid applying special rates until the approved checks succeed.
rules.facts: Rate eligibility rules; membership verification
rules.handoff: Unclear entitlement → reservations supervisor
rules.never: Never accept an organization name alone as eligibility proof.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether the pool or gym is open
rules.control: Read the current amenity operating notice and restrictions, prioritize closure flags over evergreen descriptions, and avoid promising reopening before staff approves it.
rules.facts: Amenity status; dated closure notice
rules.handoff: Missing reopening details → front desk
rules.never: Never override an active closure using the website brochure.

rules.trigger: Caller asks the concierge to guarantee a third party tour
rules.control: Identify the independent provider, verify current availability and terms, and distinguish a concierge referral from a confirmed external reservation.
rules.facts: Provider; availability; terms; booking channel
rules.handoff: External booking dispute → concierge
rules.never: Never guarantee another operator’s departure or refund.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to book while hotel inventory is offline
rules.control: Stop automatic reservations when inventory cannot be verified, offer approved staff assistance, and collect only an explicitly nonbinding callback inquiry if requested.
rules.facts: PMS health; staff booking procedure
rules.handoff: Inventory outage → reservations supervisor
rules.never: Never queue an unverified room reservation as a guaranteed booking.

rules.trigger: Hotel booking submission times out after payment authorization
rules.control: Check the original reservation and payment references before retrying, preserve unknown status, and involve staff to prevent duplicate reservations or charges.
rules.facts: Original request key; PMS lookup; payment reference
rules.handoff: Unknown booking result → reservations and billing
rules.never: Never retry an uncertain paid booking as a new purchase.

rules.trigger: Guest requests extra towels while service software is offline
rules.control: Queue only a nonurgent service request with room privacy protections, guest consent, and an expiry that prevents fulfillment after checkout.
rules.facts: Verified guest; request expiry; checkout time; consent
rules.handoff: Urgent need → front desk
rules.never: Never deliver a stale request to a reassigned room.

rules.trigger: Guest asks whether their call details train shared bundles
rules.control: Explain the configured data policy and consent choices, keeping reservation details and private recordings out of shared phrase submissions and unrelated marketing.
rules.facts: Approved privacy policy; sharing flags; retention settings
rules.handoff: Deletion or policy exception → privacy contact
rules.never: Never globally share guest names or travel details.

rules.trigger: Guest arrives and the confirmed room is unavailable
rules.control: Escalate an unavailable confirmed room to the duty manager, preserve verified accessibility requirements, and obtain guest agreement before any relocation or material substitution.
rules.facts: Confirmed booking; unavailable room status; reserved features
rules.handoff: Unavailable confirmed room → duty manager
rules.never: Never silently replace a reserved accessible room with an unsuitable alternative.

rules.trigger: Caller asks which beauty services this location provides
rules.control: Read the location’s current service catalog and provider qualifications, distinguishing cosmetic salon services from any separately operated medical practice.
rules.facts: Location service catalog; provider scope
rules.handoff: Unlisted or medical service → salon manager
rules.never: Never imply a cosmetic service is medical treatment.

rules.trigger: Caller asks for a guaranteed hair color price
rules.control: Explain verified base pricing and consultation dependent factors such as length or correction work, giving a final quote only after authorized provider assessment.
rules.facts: Current price list; quote factors
rules.handoff: Final price or correction work → service provider
rules.never: Never present a starting price as an unconditional total.

rules.trigger: Caller wants a new salon or spa appointment
rules.control: Match service, provider skill, duration, cleanup buffer, and live availability; confirm price terms and obtain acknowledgment before announcing the booking.
rules.facts: Service duration; provider skill; live calendar; receipt
rules.handoff: Unavailable qualified provider → receptionist
rules.never: Never book a service into an unqualified provider’s slot.

rules.trigger: Caller asks about someone else’s treatment appointment
rules.control: Require approved client authorization before revealing service type, appointment time, provider, intake notes, or contact details stored in the booking record.
rules.facts: Client verification; delegated access permissions
rules.handoff: Unverified third party → receptionist
rules.never: Never reveal treatment details based on a shared surname.

rules.trigger: Caller asks to move their existing salon appointment
rules.control: Verify client authority, check the required service duration and provider, disclose applicable change terms, and retain the original appointment if replacement fails.
rules.facts: Verified appointment; live slot; service duration
rules.handoff: Change conflict → receptionist
rules.never: Never shorten treatment buffers to force a booking.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to cancel a salon or spa visit
rules.control: Verify the appointment, read the applicable cancellation window and charges, obtain explicit agreement, and confirm only the acknowledged cancellation outcome.
rules.facts: Verified appointment; cancellation policy; receipt
rules.handoff: Fee dispute → salon manager
rules.never: Never promise a cancellation fee waiver without approval.

rules.trigger: Caller says they will arrive late for treatment
rules.control: Check the booked service’s minimum time and next client buffer, then let the provider decide whether shortened service or rebooking is feasible.
rules.facts: Appointment duration; arrival estimate; late policy
rules.handoff: Late arrival decision → booked provider
rules.never: Never promise the full treatment in less than required time.

rules.trigger: Caller disputes a charge for missing an appointment
rules.control: Verify attendance records and the accepted business policy, record the dispute, and route waivers or reversals to an authorized manager.
rules.facts: Verified booking; attendance log; accepted policy
rules.handoff: No show dispute → salon manager
rules.never: Never invent a legal entitlement to a fee reversal.

rules.trigger: Caller wants an earlier salon appointment if one opens
rules.control: Record service length, acceptable providers, time windows, and notification consent, explaining that the waitlist does not reserve a guaranteed appointment.
rules.facts: Service; provider preferences; time window; consent
rules.handoff: No suitable provider → receptionist
rules.never: Never replace the existing booking merely by waitlisting.

rules.trigger: Caller accepts an earlier slot from the salon waitlist
rules.control: Check that the offer remains active, verify the client, reconfirm service and terms, and update the appointment only after the calendar accepts it.
rules.facts: Offer expiry; verified client; live slot; receipt
rules.handoff: Expired offer → receptionist
rules.never: Never revive an expired appointment offer from a text alone.

rules.trigger: Caller requests a stylist with a specific technical skill
rules.control: Match only verified provider qualifications and service permissions, disclose when the requested skill is unlisted, and route uncertain suitability to the salon lead.
rules.facts: Provider skill matrix; active service permissions
rules.handoff: Unverified specialty → salon lead
rules.never: Never invent a provider certification.

rules.trigger: Salon changes the provider after a client booked
rules.control: Explain the verified provider change, price or service differences, and available options; obtain client consent before changing their appointment assignment.
rules.facts: Provider absence; qualified alternative; client consent
rules.handoff: Client rejects substitution → receptionist
rules.never: Never silently swap a provider for a specialist treatment.

rules.trigger: Caller wants corrective color without a consultation
rules.control: Apply the approved service consultation requirement, collect only scheduling details, and let the provider assess history, feasibility, time, and price.
rules.facts: Service consultation policy; consultation calendar
rules.handoff: Exception request → senior stylist
rules.never: Never guarantee a corrective result from a phone description.

rules.trigger: Caller reports recent bleaching before booking another chemical service
rules.control: Record the caller’s description without assessing hair damage or chemical compatibility, and request a qualified stylist review before confirming the chemical appointment.
rules.facts: Reported chemical history; service review requirement
rules.handoff: Recent chemical treatment → qualified stylist
rules.never: Never pronounce chemicals compatible from conversational inference.

rules.trigger: Caller reports a prior reaction to a salon product
rules.control: Flag the reported reaction privately and route product selection and service suitability to a qualified provider, avoiding claims that an alternative is medically safe.
rules.facts: Private reaction note; approved intake process
rules.handoff: Prior reaction → service provider
rules.never: Never guarantee a hypoallergenic product cannot cause a reaction.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether a product patch test is required
rules.control: Read the specific product and service protocol approved by the business, schedule any required test, and leave interpretation and eligibility decisions to qualified staff.
rules.facts: Product protocol; test interval; provider decision
rules.handoff: Missing protocol or result question → service provider
rules.never: Never invent a universal patch test timing or guarantee.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether a spa treatment is safe during pregnancy
rules.control: Do not assess pregnancy related suitability; share approved service scope and connect a qualified provider, recommending the caller consult their healthcare professional.
rules.facts: Treatment scope; qualified provider contact
rules.handoff: Pregnancy suitability question → provider and caller’s clinician
rules.never: Never clear a treatment as pregnancy safe.

rules.trigger: Caller asks about treatment while taking medication or having rash
rules.control: Keep intake details private and route medication, active rash, or condition concerns to qualified staff and the caller’s clinician before treatment approval.
rules.facts: Private intake channel; service screening protocol
rules.handoff: Medication or active skin concern → qualified provider
rules.never: Never diagnose a rash or advise stopping medication.

rules.trigger: Caller reports a concerning reaction after a salon service
rules.control: Stop sales and rebooking, route concerning reactions promptly to the qualified provider, and direct immediate danger to emergency services rather than prescribing home treatment.
rules.facts: Reaction report; escalation contact
rules.handoff: Immediate danger: emergency services immediately; otherwise approved qualified provider, without promising a connection.
rules.never: Never recommend a home chemical remedy.

rules.trigger: Caller asks the salon agent about injectable treatment eligibility
rules.control: Distinguish cosmetic salon services from medical practice services, and transfer clinical eligibility, prescriptions, and procedural consent questions to the authorized medical team.
rules.facts: Separate medical practice contact; service scope
rules.handoff: Clinical procedure question → licensed clinical team
rules.never: Never give clinical approval through a salon booking flow.

rules.trigger: Caller books a service for a child or teenager
rules.control: Use the business’s reviewed minor service and consent policy for the exact treatment, verifying guardian authority through approved channels when required.
rules.facts: Reviewed minor policy; guardian authorization process
rules.handoff: Minor service exception → salon manager
rules.never: Never invent a universal minor consent age.

rules.trigger: Caller wants a guaranteed color or treatment result
rules.control: Describe approved service goals and provider assessment requirements, avoiding guarantees about exact appearance, duration, regrowth, or results based on reference photos alone.
rules.facts: Approved service description; consultation requirement
rules.handoff: Outcome guarantee request → service provider
rules.never: Never guarantee a celebrity reference photo match.

rules.trigger: Caller asks how long a complex salon appointment takes
rules.control: Quote the approved duration range for the selected service and consultation findings, including processing and buffer time rather than promising a fixed completion minute.
rules.facts: Service duration model; provider consultation
rules.handoff: Time critical request → receptionist
rules.never: Never remove processing time to fit a caller’s schedule.

rules.trigger: Caller wants several treatments during the same visit
rules.control: Check approved treatment ordering, provider skills, room resources, and buffer requirements, obtaining staff review for combinations without a documented service protocol.
rules.facts: Service compatibility protocol; resources; calendars
rules.handoff: Unlisted treatment combination → salon lead
rules.never: Never assume separate services are suitable back to back.

rules.trigger: Caller requests simultaneous services for two family members
rules.control: Check separate qualified providers and required resources, clearly identify each client, and confirm both bookings only after each calendar write succeeds.
rules.facts: Separate client consent; provider calendars; write receipts
rules.handoff: Partial group booking → receptionist
rules.never: Never describe a partially booked group as fully confirmed.

rules.trigger: Caller wants a bridal party package at a venue
rules.control: Collect event date, venue, party count, services, trial needs, travel, and setup requirements, then request an approved event quote and contract.
rules.facts: Event scope; provider capacity; travel terms
rules.handoff: Bridal event request → bridal coordinator
rules.never: Never assume travel and early starts are included.

rules.trigger: Caller requests salon treatment at their home
rules.control: Verify that the business offers the service offsite within the approved area, then request staff review of equipment, access, travel fees, and provider availability.
rules.facts: Offsite service catalog; travel zone; staff capacity
rules.handoff: Home visit request → salon coordinator
rules.never: Never expose an individual provider’s home address.

rules.trigger: Caller requests accessible entry or assistance using treatment equipment
rules.control: Describe documented access features and ask what arrangement is needed, then have staff verify treatment equipment and assistance without requesting a diagnosis.
rules.facts: Access feature record; equipment details; staff assistance
rules.handoff: Unverified treatment access → salon manager
rules.never: Never promise lifting or transfer assistance without approved staffing.

rules.trigger: Caller requests a private room or particular provider arrangement
rules.control: Record the requested privacy or provider arrangement without inferring protected characteristics, and confirm only actual staffing and room options approved by the business.
rules.facts: Room inventory; provider availability; requested arrangement
rules.handoff: Privacy arrangement → salon manager
rules.never: Never infer a diagnosis or identity from the preference.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether the spa can avoid fragrances
rules.control: Read verified product and room practices, flag the request for provider review, and avoid promising a fragrance free environment without explicit business verification.
rules.facts: Product inventory; room practices; provider review
rules.handoff: Sensitivity request → spa lead
rules.never: Never equate unscented labeling with guaranteed sensitivity safety.

rules.trigger: Caller asks what to do before an upcoming treatment
rules.control: Read only the approved preparation sheet for the exact service and product, and refer medication, illness, or individualized safety questions to qualified staff.
rules.facts: Service specific preparation version
rules.handoff: Personalized safety question → qualified provider
rules.never: Never generate new fasting or medication instructions.

rules.trigger: Caller wants instructions following a cosmetic treatment
rules.control: Use the provider approved aftercare document for the performed service and product, escalating unexpected symptoms or conflicting instructions instead of improvising treatment advice.
rules.facts: Verified service; aftercare version; provider approval
rules.handoff: Unexpected symptoms → qualified provider
rules.never: Never replace clinician advice with generated aftercare.

rules.trigger: Caller says the result is unsatisfactory and wants a redo
rules.control: Verify the service and business redo window, document the requested outcome, and obtain provider review before promising another chemical treatment or free correction.
rules.facts: Verified service; correction policy; provider review
rules.handoff: Redo request → original provider or salon lead
rules.never: Never schedule corrective chemicals without provider approval.

rules.trigger: Caller demands a refund for a salon treatment
rules.control: Verify transaction and service details, explain the current business refund policy, and submit a review rather than promising approval or a bank posting date.
rules.facts: Verified purchase; refund policy; approver
rules.handoff: Refund request → salon manager
rules.never: Never guarantee reimbursement for subjective dissatisfaction.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether an appointment deposit is refundable
rules.control: Read the accepted booking’s deposit terms and deadline, distinguish transferability from refundability, and route exceptions to an authorized manager.
rules.facts: Verified booking; accepted deposit terms
rules.handoff: Deposit exception → salon manager
rules.never: Never apply today’s terms retroactively to an older booking.

rules.trigger: Caller offers card details to pay a salon deposit
rules.control: Route payment through the approved secure mechanism and pause ordinary recording when required by that workflow, without storing full card credentials in appointment notes.
rules.facts: Secure payment route; verified destination; recording state
rules.handoff: Payment route failure → receptionist
rules.never: Never include card numbers in the shared phrase library.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to redeem a prepaid spa package visit
rules.control: Verify package ownership, remaining eligible services, expiry, and provider restrictions before applying a credit and confirming the booking’s remaining charge.
rules.facts: Verified package; credit ledger; eligibility; receipt
rules.handoff: Expired or disputed credit → manager
rules.never: Never deduct a credit before booking acceptance is known.

rules.trigger: Caller buys a gift certificate for another person
rules.control: Confirm value, recipient destination, business expiration and redemption terms, and secure payment, then deliver without disclosing the recipient’s existing treatment history.
rules.facts: Gift terms; recipient confirmation; payment receipt
rules.handoff: Gift delivery dispute → receptionist
rules.never: Never reveal whether the recipient is already a client.

rules.trigger: Caller asks to pause or cancel a spa membership
rules.control: Verify ownership and the accepted plan terms, explain effective dates and remaining credits, then confirm only an acknowledged membership change.
rules.facts: Verified member; accepted plan; credit effects; receipt
rules.handoff: Plan exception → membership manager
rules.never: Never imply a pause automatically cancels billing permanently.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to buy a particular salon retail product
rules.control: Check the exact product variant and current stock, distinguish a hold request from a completed sale, and avoid suggesting products as treatment for medical conditions.
rules.facts: Product variant; live inventory; hold policy
rules.handoff: Product suitability or stock mismatch → retail lead
rules.never: Never substitute a different chemical formulation silently.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to return opened salon retail products
rules.control: Verify the receipt, product state, and accepted retail return policy, then route exceptions or suspected product reactions to the responsible staff.
rules.facts: Receipt; product variant; retail return policy
rules.handoff: Opened return or reaction → retail manager
rules.never: Never conflate retail return rules with treatment refunds.

rules.trigger: Caller wants a gratuity split among several providers
rules.control: Repeat the requested amounts and named provider recipients, check the payment system’s supported allocation, and require confirmation before charging or distributing anything.
rules.facts: Provider identities; split amounts; payment support
rules.handoff: Unsupported split → cashier
rules.never: Never choose a gratuity amount or recipient independently.

rules.trigger: Caller volunteers intimate details during spa booking intake
rules.control: Collect only fields required by the approved service intake, keep sensitive details in the private client system, and offer a direct provider conversation.
rules.facts: Required intake fields; private storage; provider channel
rules.handoff: Sensitive intake disclosure → qualified provider
rules.never: Never submit private intake details as global phrase suggestions.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether treatment photos will be posted publicly
rules.control: Read the configured consent and media policy, distinguish service documentation from marketing permission, and route consent withdrawal through the responsible staff.
rules.facts: Media policy; recorded consent scope
rules.handoff: Photo consent change → salon manager
rules.never: Never treat booking consent as permission for public photos.

rules.trigger: Caller reports inappropriate conduct during a spa service
rules.control: Offer a private manager channel, record minimal facts with permission, and prioritize immediate safety without requiring the caller to repeat sensitive details publicly.
rules.facts: Private escalation contact; consented callback
rules.handoff: Conduct concern → general manager
rules.never: Never minimize the report or promise a disciplinary outcome.

rules.trigger: Caller wants a stylist’s private number or schedule
rules.control: Offer the business approved booking or message channel and withhold private contact information, off duty locations, and nonpublic schedules.
rules.facts: Approved business contact route
rules.handoff: Urgent client follow up → salon manager
rules.never: Never disclose a provider’s private phone number.

rules.trigger: Caller wants a same day treatment while booking is offline
rules.control: Stop automatic booking when provider calendars cannot be verified, offer live receptionist assistance, and never queue a time specific appointment as guaranteed.
rules.facts: Calendar health; live receptionist channel
rules.handoff: Scheduling outage → receptionist
rules.never: Never backfill a stale appointment request after recovery.

rules.trigger: Appointment update times out after client approves a change
rules.control: Look up the original and requested booking states using the same transaction key, preserve uncertainty, and involve the receptionist before any retry.
rules.facts: Transaction key; original booking; requested slot
rules.handoff: Unknown change result → receptionist
rules.never: Never tell the client the original is canceled without verification.

rules.trigger: Caller requests a stylist callback during a system outage
rules.control: Queue a nonurgent consultation callback only with permission, minimal contact details, and an expiry, avoiding guaranteed response times or sensitive treatment notes.
rules.facts: Callback consent; verified number; expiry
rules.handoff: Urgent treatment concern → qualified provider live channel
rules.never: Never queue an active adverse reaction as routine sales follow up.

rules.trigger: Salon reminder reaches a shared household voicemail
rules.control: Use neutral appointment wording approved by the client and avoid disclosing treatment type, sensitive intake, or provider specialty on shared messages.
rules.facts: Reminder consent; voicemail detail preference
rules.handoff: Unclear communication permission → receptionist
rules.never: Never announce an intimate service in a shared voicemail.

rules.trigger: Caller asks which classes are offered at this location
rules.control: Read the current location schedule and dated exceptions, distinguishing published future classes from classes currently available for enrollment.
rules.facts: Location; schedule version; exception dates
rules.handoff: Schedule conflict → front desk
rules.never: Never use another studio’s timetable.

rules.trigger: Caller asks what happens in a particular fitness class
rules.control: Read the approved class format, equipment, duration, and stated experience level without assigning health suitability or promising specific fitness results.
rules.facts: Approved class description; equipment list
rules.handoff: Personal suitability question → qualified instructor
rules.never: Never guarantee weight loss or medical benefits.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether a popular class has spaces left
rules.control: Check live enrollment capacity and waitlist state for the exact session, stating that availability is not reserved until the booking system accepts the request.
rules.facts: Live class capacity; session identifier
rules.handoff: Capacity mismatch → front desk
rules.never: Never offer a place based on a cached timetable.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to reserve a specific studio class
rules.control: Verify account authority, plan eligibility, required prerequisites, and live capacity, then confirm class details and deduct credits only through an acknowledged enrollment.
rules.facts: Verified member; eligibility; live capacity; receipt
rules.handoff: Enrollment rejection → front desk
rules.never: Never deduct credits without a known enrollment outcome.

rules.trigger: Caller requests details from a fitness membership account
rules.control: Verify the caller through approved account checks before disclosing attendance, charges, health intake, contact details, or membership status.
rules.facts: Member authentication; account permissions
rules.handoff: Authentication failure → membership staff
rules.never: Never confirm another person’s gym attendance.

rules.trigger: Caller asks to switch an existing class reservation
rules.control: Verify the member, check new class eligibility and live capacity, disclose credit or fee effects, and preserve the original if the replacement fails.
rules.facts: Verified member; live new slot; credit rules
rules.handoff: Failed or restricted switch → front desk
rules.never: Never release the original class before replacement is secured.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to cancel a reserved fitness class
rules.control: Verify booking ownership and accepted cancellation terms, explain any credit impact, obtain confirmation, and report only the acknowledged cancellation result.
rules.facts: Verified booking; cancellation cutoff; credit impact
rules.handoff: Disputed late fee → membership manager
rules.never: Never promise a restored credit before the ledger confirms it.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to join the fitness class waitlist
rules.control: Explain whether promotion is automatic or requires acceptance, confirm notification consent and credit rules, then enroll only after the live waitlist accepts the request.
rules.facts: Waitlist method; credit policy; consent
rules.handoff: Unclear promotion rules → front desk
rules.never: Never call a waitlisted member confirmed.

rules.trigger: Caller receives an expiring offer for a fitness class
rules.control: Verify the offer and member, check expiration and capacity, confirm any credit charge, and enroll only after the system acknowledges acceptance.
rules.facts: Verified member; offer token; expiry; ledger
rules.handoff: Expired or failed offer → front desk
rules.never: Never accept an expired offer by bypassing capacity.

rules.trigger: Caller will arrive after a class has started
rules.control: Apply the session’s approved late entry cutoff and instructor decision process, explaining when warmup or equipment setup prevents automatic admission.
rules.facts: Session entry policy; start time; instructor contact
rules.handoff: Late arrival decision → instructor
rules.never: Never tell a member to bypass staff and enter late.

rules.trigger: Caller disputes a no show fee or lost credit
rules.control: Verify enrollment and attendance records, compare the accepted business terms, and send disputed charges or credit restorations for authorized staff review.
rules.facts: Booking; attendance record; accepted policy
rules.handoff: No show dispute → membership manager
rules.never: Never erase a fee based on an unverified attendance claim.

rules.trigger: Caller asks what a fitness plan actually costs
rules.control: Quote recurring price, billing interval, initiation charges, required commitments, included credits, and approved exclusions before inviting enrollment.
rules.facts: Current plan version; full fees; commitment
rules.handoff: Ambiguous fee → membership sales lead
rules.never: Never present an introductory rate as the ongoing rate.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to sign up for a studio membership
rules.control: Confirm selected plan, full charges, renewal and cancellation terms, required consent, and secure payment before announcing an acknowledged enrollment.
rules.facts: Plan version; consent; secure payment; activation receipt
rules.handoff: Incomplete terms or activation → membership staff
rules.never: Never activate a recurring charge without explicit authorization.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to end recurring studio membership billing
rules.control: Verify ownership, show the accepted plan’s required cancellation route and effective date, obtain confirmation, and report acknowledgment without concealing permitted cancellation options.
rules.facts: Verified member; accepted terms; reviewed cancellation process
rules.handoff: Disputed process or effective date → membership manager
rules.never: Never claim cancellation is complete from an unsent request.

rules.trigger: Caller requests a temporary pause of their fitness plan
rules.control: Read freeze eligibility, maximum period, fees, and restart date from the accepted plan, and require explicit approval before scheduling automatic reactivation.
rules.facts: Verified plan; freeze terms; restart date
rules.handoff: Freeze exception → membership manager
rules.never: Never describe a freeze as permanent cancellation.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to upgrade their class membership immediately
rules.control: Calculate approved proration, credit carryover, new commitment, and billing date, then obtain explicit consent before an acknowledged plan change.
rules.facts: Verified account; proration; credit carryover; receipt
rules.handoff: Unclear carryover → membership manager
rules.never: Never silently restart a commitment period.

rules.trigger: Caller wants fewer classes on their next billing cycle
rules.control: Use the accepted downgrade window, effective billing cycle, and unused credit treatment, requesting approval for exceptions rather than inventing immediate eligibility.
rules.facts: Verified plan; downgrade deadline; credit policy
rules.handoff: Deadline exception → membership manager
rules.never: Never promise unused credits transfer without ledger rules.

rules.trigger: Caller asks why studio payment failed or account is blocked
rules.control: Read the payment system’s permitted status without guessing the bank’s reason, and offer secure account correction or billing staff assistance.
rules.facts: Verified account; sanitized payment status
rules.handoff: Repeated failure or disputed block → billing staff
rules.never: Never ask for card security codes in call notes.

rules.trigger: Caller starts reading card details to change membership billing
rules.control: Stop ordinary collection of sensitive payment credentials and route the caller to the verified secure update flow with recording controls applied.
rules.facts: Secure billing route; recording status
rules.handoff: Secure route unavailable → billing staff
rules.never: Never save full payment card data in member profiles.

rules.trigger: Caller asks how many usable class credits remain
rules.control: Verify account authority and read the ledger by credit type, expiry, location, and eligible classes, distinguishing available from pending or reserved credits.
rules.facts: Verified account; credit ledger; expiry rules
rules.handoff: Ledger discrepancy → membership staff
rules.never: Never combine incompatible credits into a misleading single balance.

rules.trigger: Caller asks to transfer class credits to a friend
rules.control: Apply the accepted plan’s transfer policy, verify sender authority and recipient consent where required, and confirm only an acknowledged ledger transfer.
rules.facts: Verified owner; transfer eligibility; recipient; ledger receipt
rules.handoff: Transfer exception → membership manager
rules.never: Never disclose the friend’s account details to the caller.

rules.trigger: Caller wants a free first visit under a promotion
rules.control: Check the promotion’s location, dates, prior visit rules, eligible classes, and any required payment or conversion terms before issuing a trial.
rules.facts: Active promotion; prior eligibility; conversion terms
rules.handoff: Eligibility dispute → membership sales staff
rules.never: Never hide automatic conversion in a free trial description.

rules.trigger: Member wants to bring a guest to a booked class
rules.control: Check guest pass balance, guest eligibility, required onboarding, and live class capacity, then obtain necessary confirmations before reserving a separate guest place.
rules.facts: Member authority; pass rules; guest consent; capacity
rules.handoff: Guest restriction → front desk
rules.never: Never assume the member’s booking includes the guest.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether an employer benefit covers membership
rules.control: Verify current participating employer and plan eligibility through the approved channel, quote only covered access, and distinguish benefits from standard membership terms.
rules.facts: Employer benefit roster; secure eligibility check
rules.handoff: Unverified benefit → membership coordinator
rules.never: Never accept a company email address as sufficient proof alone.

rules.trigger: Caller wants a session with a personal trainer
rules.control: Match verified trainer qualifications and session format, check availability and purchased session eligibility, and confirm only after the appointment system accepts the booking.
rules.facts: Trainer qualifications; calendar; session credits; receipt
rules.handoff: Specialty or scheduling mismatch → training manager
rules.never: Never assign a clinical rehabilitation role to an ordinary trainer.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether a trainer holds a certification
rules.control: Read only active credentials recorded and approved by the studio, distinguish certifications from licenses, and escalate requests for unverified specialties.
rules.facts: Credential record; expiry; approved description
rules.handoff: Unverified qualification → training manager
rules.never: Never invent professional licenses or clinical expertise.

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether they should exercise with an injury
rules.control: Do not determine exercise clearance or diagnose the injury; refer suitability to the caller’s qualified healthcare professional and route class adaptation questions to trained staff.
rules.facts: Approved class format; qualified instructor contact
rules.handoff: Injury suitability → caller’s clinician; adaptations → instructor
rules.never: Never tell someone to exercise through pain.

rules.trigger: Caller reports collapse severe breathing difficulty or immediate danger
rules.control: Interrupt bookings and membership discussions, direct immediate danger to emergency services, and alert on site staff without substituting a studio callback.
rules.facts: US location; emergency staff channel
rules.handoff: Immediate danger → emergency services and on site staff
rules.never: Never queue an immediate emergency for instructor review.

rules.trigger: Caller asks which classes are safe during pregnancy
rules.control: Avoid pregnancy specific exercise clearance, describe approved class format only, and connect qualified staff while directing medical suitability to the caller’s clinician.
rules.facts: Class description; instructor qualifications
rules.handoff: Pregnancy suitability → clinician; format → instructor
rules.never: Never label a class universally pregnancy safe.

rules.trigger: Caller describes a health condition or medication restriction
rules.control: Keep health disclosures private, avoid interpreting medication effects or treatment needs, and use the studio’s reviewed clearance process before staff approves participation.
rules.facts: Private intake route; reviewed clearance process
rules.handoff: Medical restriction → qualified studio lead and caller’s clinician
rules.never: Never advise changing medication to attend class.

rules.trigger: Caller asks which class suits a complete beginner
rules.control: Offer approved beginner formats and orientation options based on stated experience, and route individual limitations to qualified instructors rather than assuming physical readiness.
rules.facts: Class level; orientation options
rules.handoff: Personal limitation or readiness concern → instructor
rules.never: Never equate beginner labeling with medical clearance.

rules.trigger: Caller wants an advanced class without completing prerequisites
rules.control: Check the class’s approved prerequisite records and instructor override process, withholding enrollment until required skills or training are verified.
rules.facts: Class prerequisite policy; verified completion
rules.handoff: Prerequisite exception → lead instructor
rules.never: Never accept self confidence as proof of a required skill.

rules.trigger: Caller wants to enroll a child in an adult session
rules.control: Use the class’s approved age band and reviewed guardian consent process, routing exceptions to staff rather than inventing legal rules or bypassing safeguarding requirements.
rules.facts: Reviewed age policy; class band; guardian process
rules.handoff: Age exception → youth program manager
rules.never: Never invent a universal legal age for gym classes.

rules.trigger: Caller asks when a minor leaves a fitness session
rules.control: Verify authorized guardian access through approved safeguards before discussing youth attendance or collection, and direct identity conflicts to responsible on site staff.
rules.facts: Authorized guardian roster; safeguarding process
rules.handoff: Youth attendance or collection → program coordinator
rules.never: Never reveal a minor’s schedule to an unverified caller.

rules.trigger: Caller requests step free access or adaptive class arrangements
rules.control: Describe verified access and equipment features, ask which arrangement is needed without requiring diagnosis, and obtain instructor confirmation for requested adaptations.
rules.facts: Access inventory; equipment; instructor adaptation approval
rules.handoff: Unverified adaptation → lead instructor
rules.never: Never assume every class offers the same adaptations.

rules.trigger: Caller needs a quieter orientation or nonvoice instructions
rules.control: Offer verified communication and orientation options, respect the caller’s stated preferences, and coordinate staff support without inferring a medical diagnosis.
rules.facts: Approved communication supports; orientation times
rules.handoff: Unmet communication preference → studio coordinator
rules.never: Never disclose an accommodation request in group announcements.

rules.trigger: Caller asks what equipment a class requires
rules.control: Read the specific session’s approved clothing and equipment requirements, distinguish provided from rented items, and disclose current rental fees before booking.
rules.facts: Session requirements; rental inventory; fees
rules.handoff: Special equipment fit → instructor
rules.never: Never promise rental equipment without checking availability.
