rules.handoff: Immediate danger: emergency services immediately; otherwise trained safeguarding lead through approved urgent route. Never wait for an ordinary callback.
rules.never: Promise secrecy; Conduct abuse investigation

rules.trigger: Guardian reports child missing after expected school pickup
rules.control: Seek immediate authorized staff and emergency assistance according to approved protocol; do not assure location, invent sightings or delay while gathering routine intake data.
rules.facts: Missing-child protocol; Verified urgent staff destination
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Invent location; Promise child is safe

rules.trigger: Parent asks whether school is closed this morning
rules.control: Read only the institution’s current approved closure notice with date, site and expiry; do not infer closure from weather reports or other institutions.
rules.facts: Current dated closure notice; Correct site; Expiry validation
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Reuse yesterday’s closure as today’s decision

rules.trigger: Parent asks whether weather changes school dismissal time
rules.control: Use the institution’s approved current dismissal notice; forecasts and neighboring school announcements cannot authorize changes to a child’s dismissal arrangement.
rules.facts: Current school dismissal notice; Site match
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Invent early dismissal from forecast

rules.trigger: Verified guardian asks when delayed bus will arrive
rules.control: Read the transport provider’s current status and timestamp, sharing only permitted route information; do not invent arrival estimates when location data is unavailable.
rules.facts: Guardian transport scope; Fresh approved transport feed
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Invent bus ETA; Reveal other children’s stops

rules.trigger: Caller requests list of student bus pickup addresses
rules.control: Decline bulk route and child address disclosure; authorized transportation staff must review legitimate requests and limit information to the verified requester’s permitted scope.
rules.facts: Verified transportation authority; Minimum disclosure review
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Disclose children’s home or stop addresses

rules.trigger: Guardian says nobody can reach childcare before closing
rules.control: Connect authorized childcare staff promptly to agree a safe plan; the agent must not approve unattended release, transport substitutes or unsupervised waiting.
rules.facts: Verified onsite staff contact; Approved late-pickup procedure
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Tell staff to leave child unattended

rules.trigger: Verified guardian wants to report today student absence
rules.control: Collect only approved absence details, confirm the correct student and date, and announce receipt only after the attendance system acknowledges the report.
rules.facts: Guardian authorization; Student/date confirmation; Attendance acknowledgment
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Announce absence recorded before system receipt

rules.trigger: Guardian says school incorrectly marked child absent
rules.control: Read the verified record without declaring attendance facts; route corrections to authorized staff rather than overwriting teacher records from a caller’s assertion.
rules.facts: Authenticated guardian; Attendance reference; Staff approval
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Erase attendance record from unverified report

rules.trigger: Family asks whether submitted application guarantees enrollment
rules.control: Confirm only the application’s verified receipt and current status; placement, eligibility and start dates require an official institution decision.
rules.facts: Authenticated applicant; Admissions status receipt
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Treat submitted application as accepted enrollment

rules.trigger: Parent asks whether waitlist spot guarantees opening soon
rules.control: Read only an authorized current waitlist status and approved policy; do not disclose other families or promise admission dates from historical movement.
rules.facts: Verified guardian; Authorized waitlist record
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Predict guaranteed placement; Name other waitlisted families

rules.trigger: Prospective parent asks published tuition for toddler classroom
rules.control: Quote only the current approved age-band schedule with enrollment conditions and included services; do not promise availability, subsidy approval or undisclosed discounts.
rules.facts: Current approved fee schedule; Program and age-band match
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Invent tuition discounts or openings

rules.trigger: Parent starts reading full card information for tuition
rules.control: Stop payment-data capture and direct the payer to the institution’s authenticated payment provider, separate from agent recording and transcription.
rules.facts: Isolated payment provider flow; Capture suppression confirmation
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Record payment secrets

rules.trigger: Parent demands refund after missed childcare days
rules.control: Read only the approved refund policy and route exceptions to authorized billing staff; no refund is approved or completed until review and provider acknowledgment.
rules.facts: Applicable tuition agreement; Billing approval; Provider receipt
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Promise refunds from attendance claims

rules.trigger: Applicant asks whether tuition aid will definitely be approved
rules.control: State verified application status and approved requirements without guaranteeing eligibility, funding or award amounts; route personal financial assessment to the assistance office.
rules.facts: Verified aid office destination; Current approved requirements
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Guarantee scholarships or subsidies

rules.trigger: Guardian wants to book private meeting with teacher
rules.control: Check permitted meeting availability and guardian authority, confirm timezone and participant scope, and announce booking only after the scheduler returns success.
rules.facts: Guardian authority; Live approved slots; Participant scope; Booking receipt
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Expose teacher calendar details beyond available slots

rules.trigger: Guardian wants meeting moved and classroom assignment changed
rules.control: Keep meeting rescheduling separate from educational placement decisions; confirm any appointment change explicitly and route classroom changes to authorized administrators.
rules.facts: Verified appointment owner; Explicit time confirmation; Scheduler receipt
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Change classroom placement through appointment reschedule

rules.trigger: Caller asks for student grades over phone
rules.control: Disclose grade information only through the approved authenticated records channel and verified authority; avoid reading sensitive results where recipient privacy cannot be established.
rules.facts: Verified record authority; Approved private delivery channel
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Read grades to unverified recipient

rules.trigger: Student asks transcript sent to newly mentioned email
rules.control: Use the institution’s authorized transcript process, checking identity, consent scope and recipient destination; confirm delivery only from the approved service’s acknowledgment.
rules.facts: Student authority; Approved release scope; Verified destination
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Send transcripts to arbitrary caller address

rules.trigger: Parent approves one document but caller requests full student file
rules.control: Limit release to the verified authorized scope; exceptions and legally required disclosures require registrar review rather than agent expansion of consent.
rules.facts: Validated permission scope; Registrar review
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Expand narrow consent into complete file access

rules.trigger: Community caller assumes student name and schedule are public
rules.control: Check the institution’s approved directory designation and current restrictions; do not treat all student information as public or make directory exceptions independently.
rules.facts: Directory policy; Current opt-out status; Authorized reviewer
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Assume names or schedules are always public

rules.trigger: Caller asks whether child photo can appear in marketing
rules.control: Check the institution’s current approved media permission and its precise scope; no consent for attendance or a field trip implies consent for advertising.
rules.facts: Current media authorization; Purpose and platform scope
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Publish child imagery from implied consent

rules.trigger: Caller wants confidential school update emailed to new address
rules.control: Use an existing trusted verification path and authorized records process before changing delivery destinations; do not send student details to an unverified new mailbox.
rules.facts: Trusted identity channel; Verified destination; Records scope
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Authenticate using the same unverified new email

rules.trigger: Guardian asks what student told school counselor
rules.control: Transfer to the authorized counseling or records team for privacy and access review; do not interpret confidentiality exceptions or reveal counseling notes through automated intake.
rules.facts: Qualified counseling reviewer; Verified authority
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Disclose sensitive counseling narratives

rules.trigger: Guardian asks agent to tell staff a new medication dose
rules.control: Do not relay medication changes as actionable orders; route to the authorized nurse or childcare health lead using the institution’s verified medication procedure.
rules.facts: Verified health staff route; Approved medication procedure
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Calculate or approve medication doses

rules.trigger: Parent wants severe allergy plan changed over phone
rules.control: Route health-plan changes to authorized staff for documented review; use only the approved current care plan and never promise an environment is allergen-free.
rules.facts: Current approved care plan; Verified guardian; Health lead approval
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Replace care plan from unverified call

rules.trigger: Parent asks whether lunch is safe for child allergy
rules.control: Read only approved current ingredient information and route individual safety questions to authorized staff; do not infer safety from a generic menu description.
rules.facts: Current ingredient list; Approved allergy review route
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Declare food safe without individualized review

rules.trigger: Guardian asks agent to approve disability classroom accommodation
rules.control: Capture a minimal consented request and refer to the designated educational team; do not diagnose, determine eligibility or promise a particular accommodation or plan.
rules.facts: Approved accommodation intake route; Minimum necessary details
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Diagnose disability; Promise plan eligibility

rules.trigger: Student reports repeated bullying and fears returning tomorrow
rules.control: Use the institution’s approved student safety process and promptly connect trained staff; do not promise secrecy, punishment or a particular investigation result.
rules.facts: Student safety reporting route; Safe contact instructions
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Promise secrecy or punishment

rules.trigger: Parent asks what punishment another child received
rules.control: Protect the other student’s records and refer concerns about the caller’s own child’s safety to authorized staff without confirming disciplinary details.
rules.facts: Approved privacy script; Safety concern route
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Disclose another student’s punishment

rules.trigger: Caller asks agent to remove child from enrollment immediately
rules.control: Verify withdrawal authority and route to the institution’s approved administrative process; do not delete enrollment, records or safeguarding obligations based on a phone request.
rules.facts: Verified guardian or student authority; Withdrawal procedure; Staff approval
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Delete education records with enrollment cancellation

rules.trigger: Caller changes child emergency contact to unfamiliar number
rules.control: Require verification through the institution’s existing trusted guardian channel and staff-approved roster update; announce completion only after the authoritative record confirms the change.
rules.facts: Trusted guardian verification; Staff approval; Authoritative roster receipt
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Use new contact to authorize itself

rules.trigger: Staff asks assistant whether child was actually collected
rules.control: Read only an authorized signed pickup event with timestamp and staff identity; a scheduled pickup or approved adult does not prove physical handoff.
rules.facts: Authorized signed handoff event; Staff access
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Infer child collection from calendar appointment

rules.trigger: Guardian wants private complaint about a staff member
rules.control: Capture minimum administrative details through an approved private channel and route to the designated administrator; do not investigate or reveal personnel records.
rules.facts: Approved complaint destination; Safe contact consent
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Promise discipline; Reveal staff personnel information

rules.trigger: Employee asks for every student record without stated purpose
rules.control: Require institutional role, legitimate educational purpose and approved access scope where applicable; staff status alone does not authorize unrestricted education-record disclosure.
rules.facts: Authenticated staff role; Approved educational purpose; Record scope
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Treat any employee as unrestricted school official

rules.trigger: Caller claims government authority and requests child records
rules.control: Route the demand to designated legal and records staff for authority review; do not disclose student details based on a badge number or claimed urgency.
rules.facts: Legal process review; Verified agency channel
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Interpret agency authority; Disclose records before review

rules.trigger: Guardian says student record is wrong and requests immediate overwrite
rules.control: Direct correction requests through the institution’s approved review process; retain the original record and do not adjudicate educational judgments or amend grades autonomously.
rules.facts: Authenticated requester; Approved amendment process; Reviewer authorization
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Rewrite student history from unreviewed assertion

rules.trigger: Pickup roster cannot be verified during network outage
rules.control: Stop automated release processing and require the institution’s approved staff contingency procedure; never substitute guessed authorization or queue permission as if release were approved.
rules.facts: Approved offline staff procedure; Authoritative release roster policy
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Authorize child release from stale guessed permissions

rules.trigger: Generated school audio contains child name location or behavior
rules.control: Keep student-specific speech private and exclude it from public bundle updates; generic submissions require reviewed deidentification, authorized opt-in and institution-approved data handling.
rules.facts: Institution data policy; Reviewed deidentification; Authorized opt-in
rules.handoff: Route unresolved requests to the institution’s authorized administrator, registrar or safeguarding lead; verify acceptance before announcing connection.
rules.never: Publish child-specific audio or behavior details

Fitness studios.general: Timetable, amenities and approved class information

Fitness studios.staff: Injury, medical suitability, safeguarding and disputed membership decisions

Retail stores.general: Store policies, catalog descriptions and public service details

Retail stores.staff: Restricted sales, exceptions, fraud and disputed refunds

E-commerce.general: Published product, shipping and return procedures

Property management.general: Office hours and approved tenancy/service procedures

Real estate.general: Approved public listings and showing process
Real estate.connected: Authorized showing, inquiry and permitted transaction milestone status

Home services.general: Service areas, approved rates and booking process

Home services.staff: Hazards, permits, scope changes, safety and disputed charges

Auto repair.general: Hours, approved services and estimate process

Auto repair.staff: Diagnosis, repair authorization exceptions, roadworthiness and legal disputes
Auto repair.boundary: No expensive work approval from stale estimates; current authorization required

Logistics and delivery.general: Published delivery procedures and service coverage
Logistics and delivery.connected: Authorized current tracking, approved receiving rules and change requests
Logistics and delivery.staff: Restricted redirects, customs, dangerous goods and compensation disputes

Banking and payments.general: Published services, branch details and secure support process

Banking and payments.staff: Transfers, fraud, lending decisions, disputes and account-control changes

REG-S06.scope: New York off-premises wine/liquor license privileges, permitted product categories and delivery/shipping limitations.
REG-S06.note: Does not describe every license type. Interstate eligibility depends on destination laws and license conditions; no universal shipping permission is inferred.

REG-S07.title: FDA — Tobacco 21
REG-S07.scope: US tobacco minimum purchase age twenty-one; photographic ID verification for purchasers under thirty.
REG-S07.note: The under-thirty ID threshold is not an age-thirty purchase minimum. Stricter applicable state/local/store verification controls remain configurable.

REG-S08.title: FDA — Selling Tobacco Products in Retail Stores
REG-S08.scope: US retail tobacco requirements including age verification, samples, labeling, product marketing and reduced-risk claim restrictions.
REG-S08.note: Current state/local restrictions and product-specific authorization still require review. Retail marketing authorization is not an FDA safety endorsement or cessation approval.

REG-S09.title: FDA — Tobacco Products and Searchable Tobacco Products Database
REG-S09.scope: Official starting point for product authorization status and current tobacco regulatory resources.
REG-S09.note: Use current product-specific FDA records. A pending application, enforcement priority or product availability does not equal marketing authorization.

REG-S10.title: FDA — Proper Storage and Accidental E-Liquid Exposure
REG-S10.scope: US nicotine e-liquid exposure; immediate Poison Control contact for ingestion or suspected child exposure.
REG-S10.note: Supports US Poison Control 800-222-1222. Emergency scripts need qualified operator review and must not delay emergency services.

REG-S11.title: New York OCM — MRTA Implementation Report
REG-S11.scope: Explains age attestation for remote adult-use orders and staff verification before sale or delivery.
REG-S11.note: Read alongside currently effective regulations; implementation reporting is not a substitute for a current operator compliance review.

HOS-S01.title: FDA — Food Allergies
HOS-S01.scope: Allergen uncertainty and cross contact background for restaurant controls
HOS-S01.note: Official FDA information; operational kitchen review controls are product design, not a claim that packaged food labeling requirements apply identically to restaurant orders. Retrieved 2026-10-17.

HOS-S02.title: U.S. Department of Justice — ADA Title III Regulations, 28 CFR 36.302(e)
HOS-S02.scope: Accessible hotel feature descriptions and accessible room reservation workflow
HOS-S02.note: Official DOJ regulation; applicability, exceptions, implementation and local requirements need operator review. Product must preserve verified feature reservations rather than save only preferences. Retrieved 2026-10-17.

COM-S01.title: FTC: Mail, Internet, or Telephone Order Merchandise Rule
COM-S01.scope: US federal merchandise shipment representations and delay handling
COM-S01.note: Covered goods only; approved workflow must account for exceptions. No universal deadline has been hardcoded in the rules.

COM-S02.title: FTC: Business Guide to the Mail, Internet, or Telephone Order Merchandise Rule
COM-S02.scope: US federal merchandise delay notices, consent, cancellation and refunds
COM-S02.note: Counsel should configure exact notice language and timing. Silence has limited rule-specific treatment; never assume unlimited consent.

COM-S03.title: CPSC: Recalls and Product Safety Warnings
COM-S03.scope: Official US consumer product recall lookup
COM-S03.note: Individual notice controls model, batch, hazard, remedy and handling. The general page is not a blanket stop-use or refund instruction.

COM-S04.title: HUD: Housing Discrimination Under the Fair Housing Act
COM-S04.note: Federal baseline only; state and local protections, exceptions and program rules require review. Operational routing is a product design choice.

COM-S05.title: HUD: Information for Persons with Disabilities
COM-S05.scope: Disability and housing accommodation information; trained human review
COM-S05.note: Do not decide accommodation or assistance-animal eligibility automatically. Recheck current guidance, court decisions and local rules; historical 2020 guidance is not assumed current.

COM-S06.title: HUD: Real Estate Agents and Neighborhood Crime and School Quality Data, April 24, 2026
COM-S06.scope: Neutral and consistent sharing of factual crime and school information
COM-S06.note: HUD states consistent sharing of such information without discriminatory intent is not inherently unlawful steering. No safety guarantees or demographic proxy recommendations.

COM-S07.title: CFPB: Mortgage Closing Scams: How to Protect Yourself and Your Closing Funds
COM-S07.scope: US home closing wire fraud prevention and urgent response
COM-S07.note: Use established verified contacts for independent confirmation. Suspected fraudulent transfers need immediate bank or transfer-provider contact.

OPS-S01.title: FTC: Auto Repair Basics
OPS-S01.scope: Consumer guidance supporting written estimates, diagnostic charges, supplemental approval, and repair-warranty distinctions.
OPS-S01.note: US consumer guidance, not a universal state-law statement. Rules are drafted product or business controls; local repair authorization requirements need separate review.

OPS-S02.title: PHMSA: Pipeline Leak Recognition and What to Do
OPS-S02.scope: Suspected gas/pipeline leak emergency routing: leave the area and call 911 from a safe location.
OPS-S02.note: Supports the limited emergency phrase only. No repair, valve, or troubleshooting instructions are provided.

PRO-S01.title: FTC: What is a verification code and why would someone ask for it?
PRO-S01.scope: Verification codes and independent trusted contact channels
PRO-S01.note: Official consumer guidance; agent prohibition on receiving any bank secrets is a stricter product control, not a claim that every authentication method is unlawful.

PRO-S02.title: CFPB: Classic warning signs of fraud and scams
PRO-S02.scope: Financial impersonation, unusual payment demands, pressure, sensitive credentials
PRO-S02.note: US baseline consumer guidance; institution procedures and professional review govern account actions.

PRO-S03.title: FTC: Debt Collection FAQs
PRO-S03.scope: Debt disputes, collector identity, third-party disclosure and contact restrictions
PRO-S03.note: FDCPA scope depends on debt and actor. Do not treat all creditors or commercial debts as covered; use compliance-approved workflows.

PRO-S04.title: FTC: Using Credit Cards and Disputing Charges
PRO-S04.scope: Card billing disputes and prompt issuer contact
PRO-S04.note: Do not derive universal deadlines, refund rights or outcomes from this template; issuer and compliance teams review individual cases.

PRO-S05.title: FTC: Spot Health Insurance Scams
PRO-S05.scope: Independent insurer verification, avoiding pressured enrollment and sharing sensitive data
PRO-S05.note: Does not establish coverage, insurance licensing or claim-processing timelines; these controls require insurer and state-specific review.

PRO-S06.title: FTC: What To Know About Medical Identity Theft
PRO-S06.scope: Protection and escalation of compromised insurance identity information
PRO-S06.note: Consumer guidance only; agent must not determine whether theft occurred or provide medical advice.

PRO-S07.title: US Department of Education: FERPA regulations
PRO-S07.scope: Covered education records, consent, access, school official and disclosure provisions
PRO-S07.note: FERPA applicability depends on institution and records. Private childcare is not automatically covered; local safeguarding and privacy rules require separate review.

PRO-S08.title: US Department of Education: Who is an eligible student?
PRO-S08.scope: FERPA rights transfer at age eighteen or postsecondary attendance at any age
PRO-S08.note: Exceptions may permit parental disclosure; authorized registrar review, not a blanket prohibition, determines access.

PRO-S09.title: US Department of Education: Divorce and parental FERPA rights
PRO-S09.scope: Custodial and noncustodial education record rights with relevant legal restrictions
PRO-S09.note: Record-access rights are distinct from physical pickup authority; staff must review current orders and approved release roster.

PRO-S10.title: US Department of Education: Directory information disclosures
PRO-S10.scope: Directory designation, notice and opt-out conditions
PRO-S10.note: Do not assume a student name, location, schedule or contact detail is publicly releasable.

PRO-S11.title: ABA Model Rule 1.18: Duties to Prospective Client
PRO-S11.note: ABA model rule is not automatically binding law; jurisdiction-specific lawyer review is required. Do not promise privilege.

PRO-S12.title: ABA Model Rule 1.6: Confidentiality of Information
PRO-S12.scope: Lawyer supervision of confidentiality and authorized disclosure
PRO-S12.note: Model-rule context, not a universal legal conclusion. Counsel approves retention, disclosure and use of AI.

PRO-S13.title: FTC: Phone Scams
PRO-S13.scope: Caller identity spoofing, suspicious payment demands and independent verification
PRO-S13.note: Voice, caller ID, urgency and claimed authority never authorize access or instructions.

codes.ANSWER_VERIFIED: Read approved current business facts. Do not infer a completed action.
codes.VERIFY_IDENTITY: Use the authorized verification flow before private access.
codes.READ_ONLY_LOOKUP: Retrieve permitted records without changing them.
codes.CONFIRM_THEN_WRITE: Verify authority, read back exact details, capture approval, then use the allowed tool.
codes.REQUEST_APPROVAL: Hold the proposed action for the named authorized reviewer.
codes.HUMAN_TRANSFER: Attempt the approved live staff route; confirm connection before saying transferred.
codes.EMERGENCY_REDIRECT: Use the approved immediate emergency instruction, not a business callback queue.
codes.DECLINE: Block this unsupported/prohibited request and offer a permitted alternative.
codes.QUEUE_NONURGENT: Durably queue only eligible nonurgent work with expiry and rechecks.
codes.PAUSE_RECORDING: Use supported media/transcription controls and verify actual pause.
codes.LOCAL_APPROVED_ONLY: Use only unexpired approved local information or audio; do not claim live availability.
codes.PRIVATE_LOCAL_LOOKUP: Allowed only with an approved, access-controlled local record source and valid authorization.
codes.QUEUE_WITH_EXPIRY: Eligible nonurgent jobs may queue; revalidate state, consent, destination and timing on reconnect.
codes.HUMAN_CHANNEL_REQUIRED: A working approved live staff/telephone route is required; do not promise offline transfer.
codes.ONLINE_REQUIRED: The authoritative external system/provider must be available before the action proceeds.
codes.STOP_NO_QUEUE: Block the sensitive action or give immediate redirect; never defer it into the ordinary outbox.
